theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_blowup_integral_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn N)) (w : Rn N → ℝ) (x : Rn N), (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → IntegrableOn w (S ∩ Metric.ball x ρ) μHE[n]) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in S ∩ Metric.ball x ρ, |w z| ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in S, f (blowUpMap x r z) * w z ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
